content.title: Zodiac Watches® - Premium Swiss Dive Watches Since 1882
content.text: Wearing a Zodiac is Wearing a Piece of History In 1882 Ariste Calame, the son of a watchmaker, opened a workshop in Le Locle, Switzerland. His passion and success in crafting precise, exceptional watches charted the course for the future of Zodiac. Wearing a Zodiac is Wearing a Piece of History In 1882 Ariste Calame, the son of a watchmaker, opened a workshop in Le Locle, Switzerland. His passion and success in crafting precise, exceptional watches charted the course for the future of Zodiac. René and Maurice Calame, grandsons of Zodiac founder Ariste Calame. In 1953, Zodiac made history at the Basel Watch Fair by launching the Sea Wolf — one of the world's first dive watches. Since then, every timepiece in the collection has reflected the spirit of the original, paying tribute to its iconic legacy. COMPRESSION DIVER Defined by standout styles. Built for any adventure. SKIN DIVER Anchored in watchmaking history. Destined to be a legend. GMT Fueled by the love of travel. Made to experience it. REF. 691 Revived from the archives. Reimagined for the modern collector. Our heritage timepieces showcase reinterpretations of select archival models created during one of the most influential eras in history. Today, each watch tells a unique story of enduring craftsmanship and timeless appeal. OLYMPOS DRESS Suited for formal occasions. Perfect for everyday wear. SEA-CHRON CHRONOGRAPH Reissued from the vault. Reinvented for ultimate precision. SEA-CHRON CHRONOGRAPH Driven by excellence. Created for performance. OLYMPOS FIELD Inspired by vintage military watches. Enhanced for modern utility. Swiss Craftsmanship. Made to Inspire. Our expert watchmakers in Biel-Bienne — the heart of Swiss international watchmaking — continue innovating and pushing the limits of design to create highly technical, dynamic, vintage-inspired timepieces. A Rich History of Bold Color Zodiac’s vibrant colorways emerged in the 1960s, inspired by sea life captured by a new wave of underwater photographers. Drawn from these original pieces, today's Super Sea Wolf watches continue to break the rules with striking hues. Defy the Norm. Wear a Legend.
